item.title: Fetterman warns anti-ICE protesters: 'Don't ever, ever dox people'
item.description: Sen. John Fetterman (D-Penn.) warned protesters in Minnesota against doxing federal immigration agents amid the Trump administration’s crackdown in the state.

item.title: Judge won't order federal investigators to preserve Alex Pretti evidence
item.description: A federal judge declined to compel federal officials to preserve all evidence in the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti in Minneapolis, voicing confidence Monday that court intervention isn’t needed.

item.title: Don’t fall for fake IRS calls claiming you owe back taxes
item.description: The Federal Trade Commission reports a spike in phone calls from scammers claiming to be from the IRS and telling potential victims they owe back taxes.

item.title: Clintons agree to testify in House Epstein investigation before contempt of Congress vote
item.description: Former President Bill Clinton and former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton agreed late Monday to testify in a House investigation into convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, but the Republican leading the probe said an agreement had not yet been finalized.

item.title: Probable cause found against West Virginia woman accused in alleged Trump assassination plot
item.description: A woman accused in an alleged scheme to assassinate President Donald Trump made a court appearance in Jackson County, West Virginia Monday.

item.title: What to know about the partial government shutdown
item.description: A partial shutdown affecting much of the federal government began Saturday, but it is unlikely to last long.

item.title: Bitter cold leads to multiple water main breaks across Philadelphia
